title: Grilled Italian Herb Skewers
description: Tender vegetable skewers marinated in a blend of herbs and grilled to perfection, served with a side of crispy sesame seed bread.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, italian seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the sliced bell peppers, onions, zucchinis, and cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Meanwhile, slice the sesame seed bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
Serve the grilled skewers with a side of toasted sesame seed bread and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
